_comment: P2-7 cross-SDK golden fixture for the UMA self-dispute DVM helper (AIP-14b §8.6). Consumed BYTE-IDENTICALLY by sdk-js/tests/uma-helper.test.ts AND python-sdk-v2/tests/test_dispute/test_uma_helper.py. The quoteSelfDisputeCost numbers and the requesterForceDVM call sequence are the load-bearing invariants the §8.6 asymmetry note pins: post $500 assertion bond (escalateToUMA) + $500 disputer bond (OOV3.disputeAssertion) = $1000 total; if the DVM rules FALSE (provider did NOT deliver) the requester-as-disputer recovers $750 ($500 own bond + $250 = half the asserter bond) and loses $250 to the UMA Store. All amounts are USDC base units (6 decimals).

quoteSelfDisputeCost._note: AIP-14b §8.6 + §8.2 CASE C + §8.3 payout table. Amounts in USDC base units.

requesterForceDVM._note: The EXACT call sequence requesterForceDVM must issue, in order. step.target identifies which contract the call hits (usdc | bondEscalation | oov3). assertionId is read between the escalateToUMA write and the disputeAssertion write.
